== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Crash Landing]]. Columns cover distinct published text states in date order; the stamp row describes the displayed rendition. Revised, Japanese, foil, and Virtual printings remain in Versions. Yellow highlights mark changed words against the column before. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.

Reprints: [[Crash Landing (Revised)]] (October 1998) prints the words of the Decipher Errata 1998 column; only notation differs, so it has no column of its own.
